**All tools returned "permission required but no prompt available."** I could not retrieve any data and am not reporting any figures, since I cannot verify them and will not fabricate them.

**What I tried (6 calls, all blocked):**
1. `webfetch` → `https://www.boxofficemojo.com/year/world/2020/` — blocked
2. `webfetch` → `https://www.boxofficemojo.com/year/2020/` — blocked (tried twice)
3. `websearch` → "Box Office Mojo 2020 worldwide year chart top 10 grosses" — blocked
4. `websearch` → a second query targeting the domestic 2020 chart — blocked
5. `bash` + `curl` (with browser User-Agent, saving to a temp file) — blocked
6. `bash` + simple `curl` status-code check — blocked

The failures are permission-layer errors, not network/403 errors from Box Office Mojo — no tool ever reached the site, so I have zero real data from either page (not even partial).

**To unblock:** approve tool permissions for this session (webfetch, websearch, and bash) so I can re-run the fetches. Note also that Box Office Mojo sits behind Amazon's bot protection, so even with curl approved I may need webfetch as the primary method, and if the raw HTML returns a captcha page I'll say so rather than guess at titles or grosses.
